verdict.rationale: Snyk's Remediation Agent and CLI fixes work through pull requests (snyk-docs-21, snyk-docs-29), which inherently gives a reviewable, revertable change via git, and 'ignore suggested fixes' lets you suppress a fix (snyk-docs-5). However there is no explicit documentation of versioning, reviewing, or rolling back the automation/agent configuration itself (e.g., fix plans, MCP tool configs, or policy versions). missing for 10: explicit version history of automation runs, dedicated review UI for agent fix plans, and a documented rollback mechanism beyond git PR revert.
